platform_info.name: YouTube
platform_info.description: Handles DDPs in both English and Dutch. English and Dutch filenames are tried automatically. These data donation flows have not been tested yet, if you find anything wrong with them report to datadonation@uu.nl and they will be fixed!

description.nl: Video's die je op YouTube hebt bekeken, inclusief tijdstippen.

title.nl: Bekeken video's in de loop van de tijd

title.nl: Bekeken video's per uur van de dag

title.en: Words in video titles you watched

documentation.summary: Each row represents one video the participant watched on YouTube, including the video title, URL, and timestamp.

columns.Title: Title of the watched video.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the video was watched.

description.en: Your search queries, videos watched, and ads seen on YouTube, with timestamps.
description.nl: Je zoekopdrachten, bekeken video's en geziene advertenties op YouTube, met tijdstippen.

title.en: Words in your search and watch history
title.nl: Woorden in je zoek- en kijkgeschiedenis

documentation.summary: Each row represents one search query or video watch registered in the YouTube search and watch history, including whether an ad was seen.

columns.Title: Title of the search result or watched video.
columns.URL: URL of the search result or watched video.
columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the search was performed.
columns.Ad: Boolean indicating whether an ad detail was associated with this entry.

description.en: YouTube channels you are subscribed to.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one YouTube channel the participant is subscribed to.

columns.Channel Id: Unique identifier of the subscribed channel.
columns.Channel Name: Display name of the subscribed channel.

description.en: Comments you posted on YouTube videos and posts.
description.nl: Reacties die je op YouTube-video's en -posts hebt geplaatst.

title.en: Most common words in your comments
title.nl: Meest voorkomende woorden in je reacties

documentation.summary: Each row represents one comment the participant posted on a YouTube video or post.

columns.Timestamp: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the comment was created.
columns.Channel ID: ID of the channel where the comment was posted.
columns.Video ID: ID of the video the comment was posted on.
